scope: P1-A62 classic Guan Xing and Zhang Bao, Fuhun rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网与BWIKI经典版本关兴张苞（蜀4体力，父魂）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典关兴张苞规则：两张手牌可当杀使用或打出；出牌阶段内以此法使用的杀造成伤害后，本回合获得武圣和咆哮。该页同时提供574x761经典静态大图。
交叉核对一将成名2012经典版本、蜀势力、4体力及父魂问答：杀的使用次数仍按通常规则检查，可响应南蛮入侵，只有父魂转化的杀造成伤害才获得两个父辈技能。
按用户指定概念页区分标签与应用执行形态：父魂持续提供两牌转杀规则，因此为State；由玩家在出牌阶段直接发起，因此同时投影Active；伤害后的技能获得是原技能的强制后续而非额外可选Trigger。
核对经典父辈技能武圣的基础版本身份，运行时获得既有classic:wusheng，不混入界限突破附加条款。
核对经典父辈技能咆哮的基础版本身份，运行时获得既有classic:paoxiao，不混入界限突破附加条款。

ruleText.fuhun: 你可以将两张手牌当【杀】使用或打出；每当你于出牌阶段内以此法使用的【杀】造成伤害后，你于此回合内拥有“武圣”和“咆哮”。

implementation.activeInteraction: the shared active-skill draft selects exactly two distinct current hand cards and one legal Slash target; both physical cards enter one Slash use with explicit Fuhun conversion provenance
implementation.responseInteraction: the same exact two-hand-card conversion can answer Duel, Barbarian Assault, Borrowed Sword and Jijiang provider Slash windows without creating a separate trigger prompt
implementation.parentSkillGrant: damage from a Fuhun-converted Slash used by its owner during any Play phase consumes a turn-scoped grant marker; runtime skill discovery then exposes classic:wusheng and classic:paoxiao until the turn boundary
implementation.compatibilityRepair: the full WPF regression exposed and fixed a pre-existing legal group-card continuation where Mou Lu Meng's Yingbo gift starts after the final target and no current attack remains

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the selected physical pair, Slash target, conversion provenance, damage result and turn-scoped parent-skill grant reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v110 keeps Fuhun disabled even when package 1.89.0 is loaded; package 1.88.0 does not register Guan Xing and Zhang Bao

portrait.attribution: Official classic Guan Xing and Zhang Bao artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: active Fuhun consumes exactly two distinct hand cards in one virtual Slash and records both physical costs
damage from that Play-phase Fuhun Slash grants classic Wusheng and Paoxiao for the remainder of the turn, allowing repeated later Slashes through Paoxiao
the temporary parent skills appear as acquired runtime skills and expire at the turn boundary
a Barbarian Assault response consumes the exact pair but does not grant parent skills because it was not a Play-phase use that dealt damage
Borrowed Sword and Jijiang provider paths accept the same Fuhun pair without weakening their private response boundaries
rules v110 and package 1.88.0 preserve both pre-Guan-Xing-Zhang-Bao boundaries
the official portrait, exact skill text, active draft, turn grant state and parent-skill source labels render without clipping or binding errors
the full WPF suite passes the repaired group-card to Yingbo continuation reached by the updated current roster

excludedVariants: boundary-breakthrough or mobile Fuhun variants with different timing, draw effects or parent-skill clauses
newer Wusheng clauses beyond the existing classic:guan-yu definition
newer Paoxiao clauses beyond the existing classic:zhang-fei definition
national-war and other-product Guan Xing and Zhang Bao definitions
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
